lead: The Pelham Engagement Project exists to increase civic awareness and engagement in Pelham, NY — by making public information accessible, understandable, and actionable for every resident.

Pelham has layered government across a Town, two Villages, a School District, and County. This site cuts through the complexity so you can show up informed, ask better questions, and make your voice count.
